scripts.test: GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null node --test 'test/**/*.test.ts' && GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null bun test ./test/
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --noEmit false --declaration --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --outDir dist --rootDir . && mkdir -p dist/native/build && cp native/sandbox.c dist/native/ && (cp native/build/ask.sandbox-* dist/native/build/ 2>/dev/null || true)
